status: diagnostic only; no reflection repair enabled

method.alignment: masked affine ECC, 60 iterations, Gaussian size 1
method.bounds: singular values .90..1.10, max corner displacement 4 grid pixels
method.donors: 12 shortlisted by context; best 7 fits; at least 3 per pixel; target +/-3 excluded
method.control: same conservative masks and native-footprint guard, no residual alignment

review.inspection: All 150 decoded frames inspected in ten ordered 15-frame sheets; native enlarged PNGs 67 and 120 also inspected. Consecutive-frame inspection, not real-time playback.
observations: Fixed donors produce a dark lower-rim patch at frame 67; aligned method abstains there.
Aligned support disappears through blinks and some reopening frames.
Both methods retain the photographed softbox reflection; this video replaces only a withheld control patch.
Small differences on supported lower-iris patches are not a demonstrated full-quality repair.

limitations: Detector exclusions are not ground-truth material masks.
Eligibility uses original RGB; prediction does not use hidden RGB.
Cached landmarks are held fixed, not retracked after the perturbation.
Affine correspondence does not model refraction, pupil motion or exposure blur.
Donor agreement can be confidently wrong; compare hidden-pixel errors.
No original catchlight removal or lid/source occlusion solution is delivered.
Hair, lips and all production compositing remain unchanged.
